name: SDD Tasks Template (4 Phases, Balanced UI-API Integration)
description: 4-phase SDD with balanced task distribution and UI-API integration following the Implement–Run–Verify principle. Each phase contains 11 tasks for optimal workload balance.

phase1.title: Phase 1: Foundations & Data (11 tasks)
phase1.description: Essential foundation work: API contracts, database setup, data models, and core infrastructure.

tasks.title: [TASK-001] Generate API Contracts (OpenAPI)
tasks.description: Create comprehensive API contracts and specifications for all application endpoints and data structures
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Complete API contracts generated, all endpoints documented, request/response schemas defined, validation rules specified
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ API-First Gate compliance with comprehensive API documentation

tasks.title: [TASK-002] Validate API Contracts
tasks.description: Validate API contracts against requirements and ensure all functional needs are covered
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All requirements mapped to API endpoints, schema validation passes, no missing endpoints
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Traceability Gate compliance with requirement mapping

tasks.title: [TASK-003] Configure Database
tasks.description: Configure database with connection pooling, security settings, and performance optimization
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Database configured with proper connection pooling, security settings applied, performance optimized
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Database Gate compliance with proper configuration

tasks.title: [TASK-004] Design Database Schema
tasks.description: Design comprehensive database schema with proper relationships, indexes, and constraints
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Schema designed with proper relationships, indexes, constraints, ACID compliance
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Database Gate compliance with proper schema design

tasks.title: [TASK-005] Implement Contract Tests
tasks.description: Generate contract tests from API specification for automated API testing
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Contract tests generated for all endpoints, tests fail initially (Red phase), comprehensive test coverage
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Test-First Gate compliance with contract tests before implementation

tasks.title: [TASK-006] Develop Data Models
tasks.description: Create data models with proper types, validation, and relationships following single domain model approach
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Data models created with proper types, validation, relationships, single domain model approach
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Anti-Abstraction Gate compliance with single domain model

tasks.title: [TASK-007] Run Contract Tests
tasks.description: Execute contract tests to verify they fail as expected (Red phase of TDD)
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All contract tests fail as expected, test execution completes successfully
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Test-First Gate compliance with Red phase verification

tasks.title: [TASK-008] Implement Migration Scripts
tasks.description: Create database migration scripts with proper versioning and rollback capabilities
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Migration scripts created with versioning, rollback capabilities, tested migrations
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Database Gate compliance with proper migrations

tasks.title: [TASK-009] Define Integration Test Scenarios
tasks.description: Create comprehensive integration test scenarios for application functionality with real dependencies
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Integration scenarios cover core functionality, real dependencies used, comprehensive coverage
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with real dependencies

tasks.title: [TASK-010] Implement Model Unit Tests
tasks.description: Create comprehensive unit tests for all data models with proper test coverage
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests created for all models, test coverage ≥ 80%, tests fail initially
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Test-First Gate compliance with unit tests before implementation

tasks.title: [TASK-011] Verify Foundation Setup
tasks.description: Verify all foundation components are properly set up and ready for core implementation
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All foundation components verified, database ready, contracts validated, tests passing
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with verification

phase2.title: Phase 2: Core Implementation (11 tasks)
phase2.description: Core library implementation, data models, business logic, and basic API structure.

tasks.title: [TASK-012] Implement Core Library
tasks.description: Implement core business logic library with all essential functionality and algorithms
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Core library implemented with all business logic, algorithms working, comprehensive functionality
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Library-First Gate compliance with core library implementation

tasks.title: [TASK-013] Implement Data Access Layer
tasks.description: Create data access layer with repository pattern and database operations
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Data access layer implemented, repository pattern used, all database operations working
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Database Gate compliance with proper data access patterns

tasks.title: [TASK-014] Implement Business Logic Services
tasks.description: Create business logic services that orchestrate core library functionality
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Business services implemented, core library integrated, business rules enforced
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Library-First Gate compliance with business services using core library

tasks.title: [TASK-015] Implement API Controllers
tasks.description: Create API controllers that handle HTTP requests and responses following REST principles
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: API controllers implemented, REST principles followed, request/response handling working
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ API-First Gate compliance with proper API implementation

tasks.title: [TASK-016] Implement Authentication & Authorization
tasks.description: Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms for API access
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Authentication implemented, authorization working, security best practices followed
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Security Gate compliance with proper authentication

tasks.title: [TASK-017] Run Core Integration Tests
tasks.description: Execute integration tests for core library and data access layer
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests pass, core functionality verified, data operations working
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with real dependencies

tasks.title: [TASK-018] Run API Integration Tests
tasks.description: Execute integration tests for API controllers and authentication
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: API tests pass, authentication working, all endpoints functional
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with API testing

tasks.title: [TASK-019] Implement Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling and logging throughout the application
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Error handling implemented, logging working, graceful error responses
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Progressive Enhancement Gate compliance with graceful error handling

tasks.title: [TASK-020] Implement Validation & Sanitization
tasks.description: Implement input validation and data sanitization for security and data integrity
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Input validation implemented, data sanitization working, security measures in place
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Security Gate compliance with proper validation

tasks.title: [TASK-021] Run Unit Tests for Core Components
tasks.description: Execute unit tests for all core components and verify test coverage
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests pass, test coverage ≥ 80%, all core components tested
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Test-First Gate compliance with unit testing

tasks.title: [TASK-022] Verify Core Implementation
tasks.description: Verify all core implementation components are working together correctly
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All core components verified, integration working, ready for UI development
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with verification

phase3.title: Phase 3: UI Development with Mock APIs (11 tasks)
phase3.description: Create UI components with mock API services, platform setup, and complete user flow testing with simulated data.

tasks.title: [TASK-023] Create Mock API Services
tasks.description: Create comprehensive mock API services that simulate all backend functionality including data management, real-time communication (if needed), and core application features
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Mock API services created for all endpoints, realistic data responses, error simulation capabilities, real-time communication mocks (if applicable)
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ API-First Gate compliance with mock API contracts matching real API design

tasks.title: [TASK-024] Setup Platform Environment
tasks.description: Setup platform environment with proper configuration, performance optimization, and cross-browser compatibility
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Platform environment configured, performance optimized, cross-browser compatibility verified, responsive design working
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Performance Gate compliance with web performance targets, ✅ Browser Compatibility Gate compliance

tasks.title: [TASK-025] Implement UI Components with Mock APIs
tasks.description: Develop UI components that interact with mock API services for core application functionality, data management, and user interactions
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: UI components created for all major features, mock API integration working, responsive design implemented, user interactions functional
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Library-First Gate compliance with UI components using core libraries, ✅ Responsive Design Gate compliance

tasks.title: [TASK-026] Implement Real-time UI Updates with Mock Services
tasks.description: Implement real-time UI updates using mock real-time communication services for dynamic data updates, notifications, and status changes (if applicable)
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Real-time updates working with mock services, dynamic data updates appear instantly, status changes reflect live, real-time features functional (if applicable)
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with mock real-time connections

tasks.title: [TASK-027] Implement User Interaction Handlers with Mock APIs
tasks.description: Connect UI buttons, forms, and controls to mock API calls for core application functionality, data operations, and user interactions
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All user interactions connected to mock APIs, form submissions working, button clicks trigger API calls, error handling implemented
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Library-First Gate compliance with UI using core library services

tasks.title: [TASK-028] Implement Error Handling & Loading States with Mock APIs
tasks.description: Add comprehensive error handling, loading states, and user feedback for all mock API interactions including retry logic and graceful degradation
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Error handling implemented for all API calls, loading states show during operations, retry logic working, graceful degradation for failures
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Progressive Enhancement Gate compliance with graceful degradation

tasks.title: [TASK-029] Implement Form Validation & User Feedback
tasks.description: Implement client-side form validation and user feedback mechanisms for better user experience
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Form validation implemented, user feedback working, validation messages clear, user experience enhanced
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Progressive Enhancement Gate compliance with enhanced user experience

tasks.title: [TASK-030] Implement State Management
tasks.description: Implement application state management for data flow and component communication
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: State management implemented, data flow working, component communication functional, state persistence working
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Library-First Gate compliance with state management using core libraries

tasks.title: [TASK-031] Test UI Components with Mock APIs
tasks.description: Create and run unit tests for UI components with mock API integration
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: UI component tests created, mock API integration tested, test coverage ≥ 80%, all tests passing
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Test-First Gate compliance with UI component testing

tasks.title: [TASK-032] Test Complete User Flows with Mock APIs
tasks.description: Execute comprehensive end-to-end testing of complete user journeys using mock APIs including core application workflows, data operations, and user interactions
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Complete user flows tested with mock APIs, all major features working end-to-end, edge cases handled, user experience validated
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Test-First Gate compliance with E2E testing using mock APIs

tasks.title: [TASK-033] Verify UI Development with Mock APIs
tasks.description: Verify all UI development components are working correctly with mock APIs and ready for real API integration
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All UI components verified, mock API integration working, ready for real API integration, user experience validated
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with UI verification

phase4.title: Phase 4: Real API Integration & Verification (11 tasks)
phase4.description: Replace mock APIs with real API implementations, conduct integration testing with live backend services, and verify complete end-to-end functionality.

tasks.title: [TASK-034] Implement Real API Services
tasks.description: Implement actual backend API services to replace mock APIs including data management, real-time communication (if needed), and core application functionality
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Real API services implemented for all endpoints, real-time communication working (if applicable), database integration working, authentication implemented
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ API-First Gate compliance with real API implementation, ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with real dependencies

tasks.title: [TASK-035] Replace Mock APIs with Real API Integration
tasks.description: Replace all mock API services with real API implementations in UI components, ensuring seamless transition from mock to live backend services
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Mock APIs replaced with real APIs, UI components working with live backend, data flow verified, error handling updated for real APIs
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with real API integration

tasks.title: [TASK-036] Integration Testing with Real APIs
tasks.description: Conduct comprehensive integration testing with real backend services including data operations, real-time communication (if applicable), and database operations
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests pass with real APIs, real-time communication working (if applicable), database operations verified, all core functionality tested
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Integration-First Testing Gate compliance with real dependencies, ✅ Test-First Gate compliance

tasks.title: [TASK-037] End-to-End Testing with Real Data
tasks.description: Execute complete end-to-end testing with real data including full user journeys, performance validation, and cross-browser compatibility
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: E2E tests pass with real data, complete user flows working, performance targets met, cross-browser compatibility verified
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Test-First Gate compliance with E2E testing, ✅ Performance Gate compliance

tasks.title: [TASK-038] Performance Validation & Optimization
tasks.description: Validate performance metrics with real APIs, optimize for production deployment, and ensure all quality gates are met
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Performance targets met with real APIs, optimization completed, quality gates verified, production-ready application
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Performance Gate compliance, ✅ Quality Gates compliance

tasks.title: [TASK-039] Security Testing & Validation
tasks.description: Conduct comprehensive security testing including authentication, authorization, data validation, and vulnerability assessment
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Security tests pass, authentication working, authorization verified, no vulnerabilities found, data protection ensured
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Security Gate compliance with comprehensive security testing

tasks.title: [TASK-040] Accessibility Testing & Compliance
tasks.description: Test and validate accessibility compliance including keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and WCAG guidelines
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Accessibility tests pass, keyboard navigation working, screen reader support verified, WCAG compliance achieved
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Accessibility Gate compliance with WCAG guidelines

tasks.title: [TASK-041] Cross-Browser Compatibility Testing
tasks.description: Test application compatibility across different browsers and devices to ensure consistent user experience
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Cross-browser tests pass, consistent functionality across browsers, responsive design working on all devices
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Browser Compatibility Gate compliance with cross-browser testing

tasks.title: [TASK-042] Load Testing & Scalability Validation
tasks.description: Conduct load testing to validate application performance under various load conditions and ensure scalability
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Load tests pass, performance maintained under load, scalability validated, bottlenecks identified and resolved
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ Performance Gate compliance with load testing

tasks.title: [TASK-043] User Acceptance Testing
tasks.description: Conduct user acceptance testing with real users to validate functionality and user experience
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: UAT completed successfully, user feedback incorporated, functionality validated by users, user experience approved
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ User Experience Gate compliance with user validation

tasks.title: [TASK-044] Final Verification & Working Application Sign-off
tasks.description: Conduct final verification that the complete application works end-to-end with real APIs, all features functional, and ready for deployment
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Complete working application verified, all features functional with real APIs, deployment-ready, final sign-off approved
tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ All constitutional gates compliance verified, ✅ Working application delivered

durationEstimationGuide.description: Comprehensive guide for estimating task durations based on complexity, dependencies, and team experience

executionPolicy.description: Execution guidelines ensuring proper task sequencing and parallel execution optimization
rules: Tasks with no dependencies can run in parallel
Tasks with dependencies must wait for prerequisite completion
Critical path tasks should be prioritized
Parallel execution should be maximized where possible
Quality gates must be met before proceeding to next phase

outputArtifacts.description: Expected deliverables and artifacts from each phase

governance.description: Governance framework ensuring quality, compliance, and successful project delivery
qualityGates: All tests must pass before phase completion
Code coverage must meet minimum thresholds
User acceptance criteria must be met
reviewProcess: Peer review for all code changes
User experience review for UI components
